newsitem.title: CHINA: Jilin Chemical to issue 3-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Jilin Chemical to issue 3-yr bonds.

text.p: China's Jilin Chemical will issue one billion yuan of three-year bonds at an annual interest rate of 11 percent, the China Securities said on Tuesday.
The funds raised will be used for construction of a 300,000 tonne ethylene project, the newspaper said.
The issue will be guaranteed by the Jilin Provincial Oil Management Bureau and will be issued from February 20 to March 21, the newspaper said.
The bonds will be issued over the counter at securities companies.
The issue will be traded on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and interest and principle will be paid upon maturity, it said.
